title: EndpointResponse
description: Full endpoint representation returned by list/retrieve/create/update.

name.description: URL-safe endpoint name, unique per team.

query.description: The HogQL or insight query definition (JSON object with 'kind' key).

is_active.description: Whether the endpoint can be executed via the API.

data_freshness_seconds.description: How fresh the data is, in seconds. One of: 900, 1800, 3600, 21600, 43200, 86400, 604800.

endpoint_path.description: Relative API path to execute this endpoint (e.g. /api/environments/{team_id}/endpoints/{name}/run).

url.description: Absolute URL to execute this endpoint.

ui_url.description: Absolute URL to view this endpoint in the PostHog UI.

updated_at.description: When the endpoint was last updated (ISO 8601).

is_materialized.description: Whether the current version's results are pre-computed to S3.

current_version_id.description: UUID of the current EndpointVersion row.

versions_count.description: Total number of versions for this endpoint.

derived_from_insight.description: Short ID of the source insight, if derived from one.

last_executed_at.description: When this endpoint was last executed via the API (ISO 8601), or null if never executed.

materialization.description: Materialization status and configuration for the current version.

bucket_overrides.description: Per-column bucket overrides for range variable materialization.

columns.description: Column names and types from the query's SELECT clause.
